task_completion.description: Create 'CUT' and 'FOLD' layers with correct colors (Red and Blue).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Layer List widget in LibreCAD shows two layers named 'CUT' (with a red icon/color square) and 'FOLD' (with a blue icon/color square).

task_completion.description: Draw four 60mm x 100mm main panels starting at (0,0).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The drawing area shows four adjacent rectangles. The status bar or rulers indicate a total width of 240mm (4x60mm) and a height of 100mm, with the origin at the bottom-left.

task_completion.description: Draw top and bottom flaps extending 30mm from the body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Rectangular flaps are visible above and below the main panels. Using the grid or coordinate display, these flaps should measure 30mm in height.

task_completion.description: Draw a 15mm wide glue tab with chamfered corners on the right side.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A narrow vertical tab is attached to the rightmost panel. The top and bottom outer corners of this tab are angled (chamfered) rather than 90-degree corners.

task_completion.description: Apply correct line types: Continuous for CUT and Dashed for FOLD.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Lines on the 'CUT' layer (outer perimeter) appear solid/continuous. Lines on the 'FOLD' layer (internal creases between panels and flaps) appear as dashed/broken lines.

task_completion.description: Save the file as box_dieline.dxf in the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreCAD title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the path /home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/box_dieline.dxf.
